name: Hammock
description: Striped hammock on spreader bars and rope fans, hung from its own wooden stand
notes: 'lie' = the pelvis joint of someone lying along X, 'head' = their head centre on the pillow (-X). Node 'Bed' (bed, bars, ropes, pillow) pivots at 'bedPivot' on the hook line: rotate it about X to sway; 'lieBed'/'headBed' are the same points in its frame, so a body parented to Bed rides along.
